status: Transport audit complete at core/controller level; byte/status-only observer design insufficient; no device admission

transport.core_retry_condition: Only -EAGAIN retries; at most two master calls with default retries. Timeout checked after a call, not a lock deadline.
transport.selected_master_retry: Examined selected master does not return -EAGAIN; no core retry for its reported errors. This is not a claim about a different adapter or modified implementation.
transport.request: Same-address one-byte write then one-byte read combined into one WRRD hardware transaction
transport.data_path: FIFO for both lengths <=8; coherent DMA allocation reused as staging buffer; DMA engine not started for this short success path
transport.fifo_result: Reads 4-bit FIFO count and drains that many bytes without equality check against requested length; zero count skips drain but transport may return num=2
transport.irq_result: IRQ handler records status and sets trans_stop; normal success path rejects ACK/NACK bits but does not explicitly require completion bit
transport.scp_loop: For adapter IDs 0 or 1, outer loop can invoke get_scp_semaphore 101 times because call precedes count>0 check; nested helper cost not reviewed here
transport.failure_effects: ACK error or wait timeout resets I2C, reapplies configuration/timing, warm-resets DMA, waits 5 us, and BUGs if DMA EN remains nonzero. Conditional appm semaphore exhaustion can also BUG.
transport.latency_limit: 200-jiffy hardware wait is not an end-to-end deadline: charger mutex, adapter rt_mutex, controller mutex, clock operations and nested semaphore helpers remain outside it.

decision.rejected: A new local result beside bq25890_read_byte return alone cannot prove actual one-byte FIFO completion
decision.next: Prepare narrowly scoped default-off observer with same-operation controller completion/FIFO count attribution; require count=1, completion bit, no ACK/NACK, FIFO/WRRD path and successful helper return before publishing REG06 value. Resolve bound adapter identity and nested semaphore budget first.
decision.prohibited: No extra diagnostic read, broad dump, alternate raw transport, global retry setting change, policy write, or unreviewed reset bypass.

limitations: No live charger transaction or abnormal FIFO/IRQ result observed
No observer implementation, compile, candidate or device admission
Retained binary/setup evidence does not establish live adapter fields or binding
No global wall-clock bound or successful cleanup claimed
redactions: Facts and hashes only; source/binary/disassembly and raw captures remain private
